name: survey-brief
title: Survey review brief
for_each: select id,code from surveys order by code

sections.title: Purpose and owner
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,purpose,retention_days from surveys where id=$1

sections.title: Scores
sections.sql: select sc.* from scorecards sc join surveys s on s.code=sc.survey where s.id=$1

sections.title: Actions
sections.sql: select a.* from action_queue a join surveys s on s.code=a.survey where s.id=$1

name: follow-up-paper
title: Internal follow-up working paper
for_each: select id,source_id from responses order by source_id

sections.title: Answers
sections.sql: select q.name,q.kind,a.score,a.answer_text from answers a join questions q on q.id=a.question_id where a.response_id=$1

sections.title: Follow-up and evidence
sections.note: Draft working paper. Verify accuracy and retention before external use.

name: retention-review
title: Retention review working paper
for_each: select id,code from surveys order by code

sections.title: Records for review
sections.sql: select source_id,respondent,received_on,review_due,verified_on from responses where survey_id=$1 and (review_due<current_date or verified_on is null)
sections.note: The configured period is a business policy. Record the reason for continued retention or arrange authorised disposal.
